iran_nuclear.name: Iran Nuclear
iran_nuclear.notes: May 7 morning deep scan: Reuters May 4 reports U.S. intelligence sees Iran breakout estimate broadly unchanged at nine months to one year, but the IAEA still cannot verify roughly 440 kg of 60% uranium and inspectors lack access to bombed facilities. No fresh 90% enrichment or device event surfaced. Probability 60%. Stable/imminent.

iran_conventional.name: Iran Conventional
iran_conventional.notes: May 7 morning deep scan: Reuters reports a tanker hit by unknown projectiles near Fujairah after the U.S. announced a CENTCOM-backed operation with 15,000 personnel, 100+ aircraft, warships and drones to guide stranded ships through the Strait of Hormuz. CNBC says two U.S. commercial ships transited under destroyer escort and U.S. officials still judge the ceasefire below the restart-major-combat threshold. Probability 84%. Rising/imminent.

israel_lebanon.name: Israel-Lebanon
israel_lebanon.notes: May 7 morning deep scan: Al Jazeera/AFP report Israeli strikes killed at least 10 in southern Lebanon, 44 over two days, plus new displacement orders for more than 10 villages including areas north of the Litani. Hezbollah pledged continued attacks and Israeli officials signaled readiness to expand. Probability 83%. Stable/imminent.

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.notes: May 7 morning deep scan: Reuters/NATO search remains dominated by Ankara as a mediator or logistical actor in Russia-Ukraine diplomacy and NATO positioning, not a fresh Turkish military trigger. No fresh missile, nuclear rhetoric, Greece/Syria/Iraq escalation signal surfaced. Probability 9%. Stable/deterrent.

india.name: India-Pakistan
india.notes: May 7 morning deep scan: India-Pakistan search continues to surface stale 2025 Kashmir crisis/ceasefire material, not fresh May 2026 mobilization, missile activity, or cross-border strike reporting. Probability 5%. Stable/deterrent.

russia.name: Russia-NATO
russia.notes: May 7 morning deep scan: no confirmed new Russian strategic alert change surfaced, but NATO-facing risk remains elevated by Russian threats around Victory Day ceasefires, Belarus/Oreshnik deployment chatter, and spillover from deep Ukraine strikes. Probability 35%. Stable/critical.

china.name: China-Taiwan
china.notes: May 7 morning deep scan: China/Taiwan search shows Balikatan live-fire counter-landing drills involving U.S., Philippines and Japan plus prior PLA blockade/live-fire context, but no fresh May 7 PLA closure, landing preparation, or declared blockade. Probability 36%. Stable/critical.

north_korea.name: North Korea
north_korea.notes: May 7 morning deep scan: no confirmed fresh launch in the last 24h; residual risk comes from April ballistic-missile and cluster/fragmentation-warhead testing plus standing nuclear-force readiness rhetoric. No atomic detonation event surfaced. Probability 16%. Falling/elevated.

russia_ukraine.name: Russia-Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: May 7 morning deep scan: BBC reports Russian attacks killed more than 20 ahead of rival unilateral ceasefires; Ukraine also expanded deep strikes, including Kirishi/Cheboksary targets and claimed Flamingo cruise-missile use around 1,500 km from the front. IAEA/Reuters reports drone damage to Zaporizhzhia monitoring equipment and one external power line still down. Probability 72%. Rising/imminent.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: Pakistan-Afghanistan
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: May 7 morning deep scan: no fresh May 7 report overtook the April 27/May 5 pattern: Afghanistan and Pakistan accused each other of cross-border attacks after a China-mediated ceasefire, with Kunar/South Waziristan incidents keeping the truce fragile. Probability 34%. Stable/critical.

sudan.name: Sudan / Red Sea spillover
sudan.notes: May 7 morning deep scan AUTO-DETECTED: Sudan crossed the new-zone threshold with Al Jazeera, AP, CBC and Reuters-linked reporting on RSF drone attacks against Port Sudan/Khartoum airport and SAF accusations against Ethiopia and the UAE. This is a regional-war and Red Sea logistics risk, not a nuclear trigger. Probability 18%. Rising/elevated.
